CheatEntry.Description: "Give Power-Up (enable while playing a level) (enabling failed? restart the game and Cheat Engine.)"

CheatEntry.AssemblerScript:
[ENABLE]
assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+18429A,D8 0D 3C 1B 73 00)
alloc(pmwSpeedCode,1024,"PMA_W32_M.exe"+18429A) label(pmwSpeedReturn) label(pmwSpeedDone) label(pmwSpeedMultiplier)
registersymbol(pmwSpeedMultiplier)
pmwSpeedCode: // Original instruction. fmul dword ptr ["PMA_W32_M.exe"+331B3C]
// Preserve the registers and CPU flags used by our check. pushfd push eax
// Resolve the current player object. mov eax,["PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF3C] test eax,eax je pmwSpeedDone
mov eax,[eax+24] cmp esi,eax jne pmwSpeedDone
// Scale the freshly calculated magnitude for Pac-Man only. fmul dword ptr [pmwSpeedMultiplier]
pmwSpeedDone: pop eax popfd jmp pmwSpeedReturn
pmwSpeedMultiplier: dd (float)1.25
"PMA_W32_M.exe"+18429A: jmp pmwSpeedCode nop pmwSpeedReturn:
[DISABLE]
"PMA_W32_M.exe"+18429A: db D8 0D 3C 1B 73 00
unregistersymbol(pmwSpeedMultiplier) dealloc(pmwSpeedCode)

[ENABLE] assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6CE,8B 8E 78 04 00 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6E4,E8 47 72 FB FF)
alloc(pmwSJMem,$1000,"PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6CE) label(pmwSJData) label(pmwSJBase) label(pmwSJBaseDone) registersymbol(pmwSJData)
pmwSJMem: pmwSJBase: // Replay the original load; ECX holds float bits, not an address. mov ecx,[esi+478] pushfd push eax mov eax,["PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF3C] test eax,eax je pmwSJBaseDone mov eax,[eax+24] test eax,eax je pmwSJBaseDone cmp esi,eax jne pmwSJBaseDone push ecx fld dword ptr [esp] fmul dword ptr [pmwSJData] fstp dword ptr [esp] pop ecx pmwSJBaseDone: pop eax popfd jmp "PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6D4
align 10 pmwSJData: dd (float)1.25 // +00 Multiplier
"PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6CE: jmp pmwSJBase nop
[DISABLE] "PMA_W32_M.exe"+CE6CE: db 8B 8E 78 04 00 00 unregistersymbol(pmwSJData) // Retain the 4 KiB allocation until process exit: an in-flight hook can return. // Re-enabling allocates a fresh block. Pause in CE before either toggle.

// PMW3 PC: scales butt-bounce rebound launch strength at both consumers.
[ENABLE] assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA1F,D9 86 78 04 00 00 8B 96 9C 01 00 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA55,E8 C6 DC 08 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+15B6E3,8B 96 78 04 00 00 D9 87 DC 00 00 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+15B6FC,E8 2F A2 F2 FF)
alloc(pmwBHMem,$1000,"PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA1F) label(pmwBHLaunch) label(pmwBHLaunchDone) label(pmwBHUpdate) label(pmwBHUpdateDone) label(pmwBounceHeightMultiplier) registersymbol(pmwBounceHeightMultiplier)
pmwBHMem: pmwBHLaunch: // Replay the original load. Leave the player's stored parameter untouched. fld dword ptr [esi+478] pushfd push eax mov eax,["PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF3C] test eax,eax je pmwBHLaunchDone mov eax,[eax+24] test eax,eax je pmwBHLaunchDone cmp esi,eax jne pmwBHLaunchDone // Accept positive finite floats. 1.0 and invalid inputs use original behavior. mov eax,[pmwBounceHeightMultiplier] test eax,eax jle pmwBHLaunchDone cmp eax,7F800000 jae pmwBHLaunchDone cmp eax,3F800000 je pmwBHLaunchDone push eax fmul dword ptr [esp] pop eax pmwBHLaunchDone: pop eax popfd jmp "PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA25
pmwBHUpdate: // EDX carries float bits to the game's rebound target calculation. mov edx,[esi+478] pushfd push eax mov eax,["PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF3C] test eax,eax je pmwBHUpdateDone mov eax,[eax+24] test eax,eax je pmwBHUpdateDone cmp esi,eax jne pmwBHUpdateDone mov eax,[pmwBounceHeightMultiplier] test eax,eax jle pmwBHUpdateDone cmp eax,7F800000 jae pmwBHUpdateDone cmp eax,3F800000 je pmwBHUpdateDone push edx fld dword ptr [esp] mov [esp],eax fmul dword ptr [esp] fstp dword ptr [esp] pop edx pmwBHUpdateDone: pop eax popfd jmp "PMA_W32_M.exe"+15B6E9
align 10 pmwBounceHeightMultiplier: dd (float)1.0
"PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA1F: jmp pmwBHLaunch nop "PMA_W32_M.exe"+15B6E3: jmp pmwBHUpdate nop
[DISABLE] "PMA_W32_M.exe"+15BA1F: db D9 86 78 04 00 00 "PMA_W32_M.exe"+15B6E3: db 8B 96 78 04 00 00 unregistersymbol(pmwBounceHeightMultiplier) // Keep the 4 KiB allocation until process exit so an in-flight hook can return. // Each re-enable allocates a new block and resets the multiplier to 1.0.

// PMW3 PC: select the third normal butt-bounce attack on every stage start.
[ENABLE] assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+83383,8B 87 D0 00 00 00 3B C3 75 08 89 AE 14 04 00 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+833A5,83 F8 02 75 0A C7 86 14 04 00 00 03 00 00 00) assert("PMA_W32_M.exe"+8330A,8B 86 E0 07 00 00 B9 04 00 00 00 3B C1 DF E0 75 3B)
alloc(pmwStrongBounceMem,$1000,"PMA_W32_M.exe"+83383) label(pmwStrongBounceDone)
pmwStrongBounceMem: // Replay the original load. The real combo counter remains untouched. mov eax,[edi+D0] pushfd push edx mov edx,["PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF3C] test edx,edx je pmwStrongBounceDone mov edx,[edx+24] test edx,edx je pmwStrongBounceDone cmp esi,edx jne pmwStrongBounceDone // The original selector maps zero-based counter 2 to attack stage 3. // Super Stomp follows a different branch and never reaches this hook. mov eax,2 pmwStrongBounceDone: pop edx popfd jmp "PMA_W32_M.exe"+83389
"PMA_W32_M.exe"+83383: jmp pmwStrongBounceMem nop
[DISABLE] "PMA_W32_M.exe"+83383: db 8B 87 D0 00 00 00 // Retain the 4 KiB allocation until process exit so an in-flight hook can return. // Each re-enable allocates a fresh block. The next stage uses normal selection.

CheatTable.Comments: Beta 1.2. PS the multipliers might not be on a linear scale.
